exo01/analysis.py.name: The conductor
exo01/analysis.py.description: Runs one complete case in order: weight and balance, how it floats, how it leans, the boat alongside, the motors, then the wave behaviour.

exo01/jobs.py.name: Slow jobs, run aside
exo01/jobs.py.description: Runs the long wave calculations in a separate process with a progress bar, so the page in the browser never freezes.

exo01/optimise.py.name: Trying many options
exo01/optimise.py.description: Sweeps battery positions on the deck or on the float frame, and rope arrangements, and ranks them with the score stated openly.
